items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: INTERVIEWER: How did you enjoy working with Joe Merez's brother? ... INTERVIEWEE: He played wonderful.

ctx.x: That's my, isn't that a foreign magazine?

Yeah, this is that English magazine. I was just checking through here to see if there's any other ideas about your life, any questions here. How did you enjoy working with Joe Merez's brother? I started to say Joe Merez. I'll change this. Paul's. Paul Merez.
He played wonderful. He played wonderful.
